statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-53495 is a resource-exhaustion bug in containerd's CRI ExecSync implementation (exec probes and lifecycle hooks with background child processes). The harbor-trivy-adapter image includes the upstream trivy binary (from dhi/trivy), which vendors github.com/containerd/containerd/v2 only for image inspection (pulling, unpacking, and parsing OCI manifests/layers during vulnerability scanning). Trivy does not run containerd as a CRI runtime, does not enable the CRI plugin, and never invokes ExecSync, so the vulnerable code path is not reachable in this image.

containerd/v2 2.3.4 is statically embedded in /usr/bin/dockerd and the docker-buildx and docker-compose CLI plugins from current docker-ce packages used by sbx-templates Docker variants. The standalone containerd.io package is already at 2.3.5, but remediation for this finding requires docker-ce (and related plugins) to rebuild against containerd/v2 2.3.5 or later.
